lines.text: The word of the LORD came through Haggai to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua the high priest.
The people said the time had not come to rebuild the house, while they lived in paneled houses.
The people planted much but harvested little, and they put their wages into a bag pierced through.
God told the people to go up into the mountains, bring down lumber, and build the house.
The heavens withheld their dew, and the LORD summoned a flood on the fields and the labor of their hands.
